prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1208; do not mention it.)
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain radiating into the right buttock, with stiffness and reduced range of motion in the lumbar spine. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and spasm without neurological deficit. Lumbar strain was diagnosed. Over the course of thirteen visits, the patient received a combination of manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise, and instruction in a home stretching program, along with short-term use of muscle relaxants and anti-inflammatory medication as needed. Pain scores improved steadily from moderate to mild, and lumbar range of motion progressively returned toward baseline. Sleep disturbance and activity limitations decreased as symptoms resolved. At the most recent visit, the patient reported intermittent mild discomfort only with prolonged sitting or heavy lifting, with no radicular symptoms. Continued self-directed exercise and ergonomic modifications were recommended. Prognosis is good, with full recovery anticipated. The patient may return to regular activities as tolerated, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
